decisions.reason: As a closely related multi-item line that stayed prominently presented in both 2023 and 2024, it likely shows enough fit and traction to justify keeping this option open at relatively low incremental cost.
The serum fits the core portfolio and remained on the website for two years, but its lower prominence suggests more uncertain demand, so it is kept while being monitored closely.
Because this cleansing oil was only launched in 2024, uncertainty about its value is still high and the firm is likely to retain it for another year unless early sales and repeat purchase disappoint.
